verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a community comment confirming that Mixpanel has group- or account-level analytics for B2B SaaS, but that it is gated to higher-priced plans. No first-party docs show how account-level funnels or retention work. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of account/company-level analysis, evidence that funnels and retention can be computed per account, plan-availability details, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can analyze behavior at the account or company level, not just per user, for B2B products

citations.quote: Group-level/account-level analytics useful for B2B SaaS is 'tucked away on one of Mixpanel's higher price plans,'
